g.text: First-Principles Dataflow: Spatial Patch Organization, Cross-Attention Affordance Grounding, and Action Decoding
RGB Camera Stream: 2D Spatial Patch Slicing
Image I ∈ ℝ^(H × W × C) tiled into non-overlapping P × P patches
Prompt: "Grasp the red mug by its handle"
Byte-pair encoded tokens: z_text ∈ ℝ^(L × d_model)
s_t = [q_t, q̇_t] ∈ ℝ^(2N_j) ⟶ Linear Projection ⟶ z_state ∈ ℝ^d
Synchronized joint angles and velocities at optical exposure timestamp
Z = [ z_vision | z_text | z_state ] ∈ ℝ^(N_total × d_model)
Tiled visual patches + instruction tokens + robot kinematic state
A_ij = softmax( Q_i · K_jᵀ / √d_k ) ⟶ Spatial Cross-Attention
Tracks object permanence, SE(3) coordinate frames, and velocities
Distilled spatial affordances and temporal mission intent dispatched to action decoders
Paradigm A: Discrete Token Binning (RT-1/2, OpenVLA)
Action space quantized into B = 256 categorical vocabulary bins:
• 7-DoF arm requires 7 autoregressive passes per control step
• 7 × streaming 7B weights from DRAM across memory bus
• Latency > 600 ms on edge SoC (violates 50 Hz control loop)
• Quantization chatter prevents smooth compliant contact
Context h_context conditions generative head to denoise chunks:
• VLA backbone evaluates once per chunk at slow rate (2–5 Hz)
• Denoising head / spline interpolator runs at 20–50 Hz in SRAM cache
• Overcomes DRAM memory wall: 10× faster control rate
• Natively captures multimodal demonstrations without mode collapse
• Emits kinematic setpoints [q, q̇, q̈], never raw torques
UNPRIVILEGED COGNITIVE PROPOSAL ⟶ DETERMINISTIC KILOHERTZ ENFORCEMENT
Hard Real-Time Safety Shield (1000 Hz on Bare-Metal Safety MCU)
1. Kinematic Slew Clamp: ‖q̇‖ ≤ q̇_max, ‖q̈‖ ≤ a_max (prevents gear shock)
2. Control Barrier Functions (CBF-QP): ḣ = L_f h + L_g h · u ≥ −α(h(x))
3. Dynamic Stopping Envelope: d_stop(v) = v · τ_delay + v²/(2 a_max) + ε_track < D_clear
Solves convex QP in static SRAM (< 50 µs); vetoes hallucinations or triggers safe stop.
• Verified torque setpoints u_t* written to PWM
"The cognitive brain proposes kinematic setpoints; the deterministic nervous system permits execution; the physical body actuates work."
